`final class SignalReplayRun`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.signal.replay` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [SignalReplayRun.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/signal/replay/SignalReplayRun.java)

One execution of a slice of bytecode, during the match or during a replay, with the signals it reads.

## Creation details

<a id="SignalReplayRun-factory-match"></a>

### match

`SignalReplayRun match(Object self, boolean definitions, List<Signal<?>> positionalList)` <span class="joid-qualifier">factory</span>

Returns a run that matches a slice against the recorded reads; `positionalList` gives the signals to use by position, or `null`.

<a id="SignalReplayRun-factory-replay"></a>

### replay

`SignalReplayRun replay(Object self, boolean definitions, Map<String,String> holeMap, Map<Object,Signal<?>> positionalMap)` <span class="joid-qualifier">factory</span>

Returns a run that computes a matched slice again, with the deduced texts and the signals matched by position.
